emma (Marketing): Quick sync  need final statuspage line + an embargoed email and a 1-line tweet. Hold public post until Monitoring. Can someone propose 2 micro-variants? @leo @toni

leo (SRE): Timeline: degraded requests 07:10 UTC, rollback 07:28, healthy 07:35. Cause: autoscaler config change triggered abnormal batching; root cause investigation ongoing. Monitoring active.

emma (Marketing): Variant A (concise):
`Service degradation impacting a subset of requests from 07:1007:35 UTC. Rollback applied; systems are healthy and under monitoring. Follow-up report to follow within 72 hours.`

Variant B (empathetic):
`We experienced degraded performance for some API requests between 07:10 and 07:35 UTC. A rollback resolved the immediate issue and services are healthy. We're validating and will publish a full incident report within 72 hours.`

toni (Support): For email subject: "Service update: performance incident resolved". I'll prepare canned replies and will tag affected accounts once I have the CSV.

sam (Legal): Avoid definitive data language. Use: "We have no indication of customer data exposure at this time" only after log confirmation from SRE.

leo (SRE): Confirm log scan in progress; should have data-language confirmation in ~10m.

emma (Marketing): Plan: 1) Post StatusPage using Variant A now. 2) Targeted email ~30m after Support uploads CSV. 3) Tweet only after Monitoring. 4) Postmortem + report in 72h. Any objections?

deploybot: Incident INC-5099 updated: state=identified. (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-5099)

toni (Support): CSV will be uploaded to /shared/incidents/inc-5099.csv in ~15m. I'll ping here when ready.

emma (Marketing): Thanks team  posting now and queuing email per plan.
